stories.headline: HKU partners with tech giants to offer AI labs at expanded Shanghai campus

opening: The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is partnering with tech giants to offer on-site artificial intelligence (AI) laboratories at its expanded Shanghai campus, which welcomed more than 300 students for the new term earlier this week.
The campus in Zhangjiang Science City is also expected to expand its intake next year, when the university’s medicine and engineering programmes launch there.
body: Its computing and data science school opened a base in Shanghai in mid-January.
